classification.summary: A UPI news report detailing a settlement between Stephen F. Austin University and the Young Conservatives of Texas regarding a free speech dispute over posted fliers. The students, supported by the ACLU, challenged a university policy that required prior permission for posting materials. The resulting settlement established new 'time, place and manner' restrictions while allowing the contested posters.
